_comment: Patterns are matched with find() against the cleaned chat line:
formatting codes removed, every [bracketed] segment removed, whitespace collapsed.
Named groups 'player' and 'critter' are what the mod reads; a capture only counts
'ignore' drops a line outright - use it for messages that name a critter without catching it,
such as uncovering a disguised Duplico, which happens several times before the capture.
when the critter group matches a known critter, so the patterns can stay loose.
Order matters: the first pattern that yields a known critter wins.
This file can be edited freely; delete it to get the bundled defaults back.
